task: S1 (ADR 0023 §23.2 decision 2; docs/reports/rl_ready/P2_REMAINING_PLAN.md §2.2): GPU smoke of the self-penetration detector surface_grid_v1
declared: 2026-11-11, committed alone and SHA-pinned (tests/test_rubber_s1_protocol.py) before any GPU run of the check

common.device: GPU0 (RTX 5090), CUDA graph chunks, under flock /mnt/data/ningan/lab_records/rcs_rl_runner/gpu0.lock
common.gpu_label: SHARED_GPU when nvidia-smi shows another compute process before, during or after the run, else EXCLUSIVE_AT_SAMPLES
common.run_meta: commit, dirty-tree flag, this file's sha256, driver, GPU name, co-tenant samples, Warp / Python versions, command
common.output: new directory under artifacts/rl_ready/p2_s1/ (refuses to overwrite)

COST.what: ms per substep with the detector on vs off (reported, not scored)
COST.scene: P2-6 profile rubber_rl_env_v1 without S1 as the off arm: case A strip 125 x 16 x 4 mm, n_t 4, dx 1 mm (rubber_ref_v1), on the table plane z = 0 (contact law grid_node_penalty_coulomb_v3 with the rubber_contact_tests_v3 parameters), gravity -z, recipe rubber_generic_visco_v1 nominal (M = 2), step material mu0 0.8 MPa / rho 1000 (5,226 substeps per 20 ms), options F8 consistent_mass_projection_v1 + kick_average_v1 + F9 grid_displacement_v1 + F10 f64_shadow_v1 + guard 1.0
COST.batches: BatchedRubberMaterial N = 1 and N = 8 (identical slots), detector on (check_substeps 256) and off
COST.procedure: per N: build both arms, 1 cold control step each, then 5 warm control steps per arm interleaved (on, off, on, off, ...), synchronised wall time per control step; ms/substep = median warm wall / substeps; overhead = on / off - 1
COST.criterion: reported; the plan estimate is <= 0.5 % of a control step

L2.what: GPU invariants of the detector-on arms of COST after their warm steps (scored)
L2.criterion: state finite (diagnostics nonfinite 0); per-env particle mass unchanged since the build; audits() empty; invalid_reason 0 for every env; detector hits 0 and checks = control steps x checks per control step for every env

TRIP.scene: tests/test_rubber_self_penetration.py fold scene (case C 24 x 3 x 3 mm, n_t 2, grip 1 lifted, carried back over the strip and driven down through its lower leg; check_substeps 8), single env and BatchedRubberMaterial N = 3 with the fold in env 1 and benign grip motions in envs 0 / 2, 140 control steps
TRIP.criterion: bit 8 set for the fold env (single and batched env 1) and for no other env; no other invalid bit before bit 8; the first-hit control step and substep reported next to the CPU value of the same scene (GPU atomics make the trajectory order-nondeterministic, so the hit time is not scored)

NO_FALSE_TRIP.what: v5 / visco regression scenes with the detector forced on (check_substeps 256), built by their unchanged builders (scored)
scenes: RUBBER-PHYS-09 v5 (rubber_phys.case_records, guard 1.0): cantilever_gravity and free_vibration at t 3 / 4 / 6 mm x W/t 1 / 4 (12 runs, 5 control steps each)
RUBBER-PHYS-09 v5 stretch_release at the same 6 sizes (the lambda 1.5 instantaneous-release fold scene of ADR 0023 §18.3): bit 8 reported, not scored
rubber_visc_tests_v1 runner jobs (scripts/rubber/p2_3/run_visc_v1.py, full length, device forced to the GPU): v03_strip_16hz, v02_creep, v04b_cantilever_x1
NO_FALSE_TRIP.criterion: no RUBBER_SELF_CONTACT_UNRESOLVED (and no other invalid bit) in any cantilever_gravity, free_vibration or visco run; detector checks > 0 in each

verdict: PASS if L2, TRIP and NO_FALSE_TRIP pass; COST is reported. A failed or aborted run is preserved and reported.
